dedupe_keys.name: safety4rails incident and crisis management tool icmt for railway and metro emergencies

description: The Incident and Crisis Management Tool (ICMT) of the SAFETY4RAILS project is an information management system for control rooms, mobile apps and web applications across the incident management process: control of assets, incident management and debriefing. The project article sets out four challenges (managing foreseen risks, collaboration among responders, roles and responsibilities, and effective decisions), describes gold, silver and bronze command levels and a crisis management group, and lists the core and peripheral control centres and on-site responders in the operating concept of deliverable D3.5. It names the Leonardo SC2 tool as an example of the approach and a training and exercise module for operators and large-scale exercises. Coverage: mainline rail and metro operators in Europe. Format and access: project documentation; the tool is not openly distributed. Licence and cost: not stated. Caveats: a research project that ended in 2022. It supports emergency response and resilience studies of rail incident coordination. It relates to the RDG emergency management code and the railway cyber range dataset in the catalogue.
